title: Arithmetic and Geometric Sequences
summary: AP or GP nth term and sum; infinite GP when |r| < 1. 64 bytes.

body.text: First prompt Y selects the family: 0 = arithmetic, 1 = geometric. Then A (first term), B (common difference or ratio), C (n). AP pauses: Tn, Sn. GP pauses: Tn, Sn, then S∞ = A/(1−B). tanh⁻¹(B) is a gate: if |B| ≥ 1 the infinite-sum step throws Math ERROR, which is the correct ‘no S∞’ signal.

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 64 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).
Example 1: AP first term 2, difference 3, n = 20
Question: Use this program to solve the case: AP first term 2, difference 3, n = 20.

items: AC — do not 【EXE】 into the GP branch

body.text: Example 2: GP first term 1024, ratio 1/2, n = 10
Question: Use this program to solve the case: GP first term 1024, ratio 1/2, n = 10.
Question: Use this program to solve the case: GP with |r| ≥ 1 (no infinite sum).
Given: A = 3, B = 2, C = 5. T₅ = 48, S₅ = 93, then Math ERROR on S∞.

items: 48, then 93, then Math ERROR on tanh⁻¹(2). That error means S∞ does not exist

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: tanh⁻¹ is SHIFT hyp tan. For AP, AC after the two pauses. Sn for GP uses A(1−rⁿ)/(1−r); r = 1 is a separate Math ERROR (division by 0) — handle T = A, S = nA by hand.
